releaseNotes: V973 strengthens the post-inference AI Grounding semantic guard without changing deterministic Operational Status or Condition Assessment evaluation.

When no explicit condition criteria exist, AI explanations can no longer expand READY/connected/no-fault evidence into healthy/normal/acceptable/expected-range claims, and anomaly/abnormal/deviation language is rejected unless criteria support evaluation.
Baseline-deviation language now requires explicit valid learned-baseline evidence; existing TrendStats direction/variation gates remain unchanged.

V972 AI Data Library, Pepperl+Fuchs branding, V970 Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, permissions, HMI read-only and Signal Tower hardware-control paths are unchanged.

en: Strengthened the AI Grounding semantic guard for criteria-gated health and anomaly language.
READY, connected ports and no-fault evidence can no longer be expanded into healthy/normal/expected-range claims when condition criteria are absent.
Anomaly/abnormal/deviation language requires condition criteria, and baseline-deviation language requires a valid learned baseline.
Deterministic evaluation and protected runtime/control paths are unchanged.
ko: Criteria 기반 health/anomaly 표현을 위한 AI Grounding semantic guard를 강화했습니다.
Condition Criteria가 없을 때 READY, 포트 연결, Fault 없음 근거를 healthy/normal/expected-range 의미로 확장할 수 없습니다.
anomaly/abnormal/deviation 표현은 Condition Criteria가 필요하며 baseline deviation은 유효한 Learned Baseline이 필요합니다.
Deterministic Evaluation과 보호된 Runtime/Control 경로는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: Criteria に基づく health/anomaly 表現を対象に AI Grounding の semantic guard を強化しました。
Condition Criteria がない場合、READY・ポート接続・Fault なしの根拠を healthy/normal/expected-range に拡張できません。
anomaly/abnormal/deviation 表現には Condition Criteria が必要で、baseline deviation には有効な Learned Baseline が必要です。
Deterministic Evaluation と保護対象の Runtime/Control 経路は変更していません。
zh-CN: 强化了基于 Criteria 的 health/anomaly AI Grounding 语义防护。
没有 Condition Criteria 时，READY、端口已连接和无故障证据不能被扩展为 healthy/normal/expected-range 结论。
anomaly/abnormal/deviation 表述需要 Condition Criteria，baseline deviation 需要有效的 Learned Baseline。
Deterministic Evaluation 及受保护的 Runtime/Control 路径保持不变。
de: Der semantische AI-Grounding-Schutz für criteria-gesteuerte Health-/Anomaly-Aussagen wurde verstärkt.
Ohne Condition Criteria dürfen READY, verbundene Ports und fehlerfreie Betriebsdaten nicht zu healthy/normal/expected-range Aussagen erweitert werden.
Anomaly/abnormal/deviation Aussagen erfordern Condition Criteria; baseline deviation erfordert eine gültige Learned Baseline.
Deterministic Evaluation und geschützte Runtime-/Control-Pfade bleiben unverändert.
es: Se reforzó la protección semántica de AI Grounding para expresiones de health/anomaly gobernadas por Criteria.
Sin Condition Criteria, READY, puertos conectados y ausencia de fallos no pueden ampliarse a afirmaciones healthy/normal/expected-range.
Las expresiones anomaly/abnormal/deviation requieren Condition Criteria y baseline deviation requiere un Learned Baseline válido.
Deterministic Evaluation y las rutas Runtime/Control protegidas no cambian.
